Triage (finding first-touch grading): promoted → `pm:queue`, `domain:ui`, type **Bug**. This is an invariant-restoring fix, not a design question: #6110 established the contract that every mount site publishes the SAME `current_user` shape via `buildExpressionUser`, and `RecordFormPage`'s hand-rolled descriptor violates it with user-visible consequence — predicates naming `ctx.user.isPlatformAdmin` or `ctx.user.id` FAULT and the visibility gate fails open (e.g. the `sys_environment` "Change Plan (admin)" action gate silently does not bite). Fail-open on an admin-gated action is the reachable harm; the fix direction tightens it back to the declared shape, so it is not an access-control relaxation and stays out of the human floor.

The card already states the correct repair shape and why the one-line import is not available (lazy-chunk edge back into `AppContent`, weighed by `check-eager-closure-budget`): move the normaliser beside the `ExpressionProvider` it feeds (`providers/`), re-export from `AppContent` and the package index so the published name is unchanged. That is scoped engineering, no adjudication needed.

Size/model suggestion: M (small module move + both mount sites + the signed-out branch + a shape pin; touches the eager-closure gate's measured surface, so the dev should run it on a built console).

Serial-constraint note for the ui seat: same `app-shell` region as the in-flight #6493/#6488 family — the claim comment's serial line should name whichever of those is still open at dispatch time.

**Dispatched** by the `domain:ui` seat. Triage's serial note is discharged: **objectui#6493 merged at 08:25Z**, so `RecordFormPage.tsx` and `AppContent.tsx` are free; objectui#6488 (PR #6518) is still in the queue but touches `services/MetadataService.ts` only, which is disjoint from your face.

**Read triage's comment before the body** — it grades this and states the repair shape, so most of what would be your open questions are already answered.

**The repair, as triage scoped it:** move the normaliser beside the `ExpressionProvider` it feeds (`providers/`), then **re-export from `AppContent` and the package index so the published name is unchanged.** Fix **both** mount sites and the **signed-out branch** — that one diverges too, since `buildExpressionUser(null)` carries `isPlatformAdmin: false` and has no `positions` gap.

**⚠️ The bundle constraint is the whole reason this was not fixed inside #6493, and it is the part most likely to go wrong.** `RecordFormPage` is `lazy()`-loaded **by** `AppContent`, so a static import from the view back into `AppContent` creates a source edge from the split chunk into the module it was split out of — exactly what `check-eager-closure-budget` weighs. Moving the normaliser to `providers/` is what avoids that edge; importing it from its current home is what recreates it.

- **Run that gate on a BUILT console.** It refuses without `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json` and says so — in a fresh worktree that is a **prerequisite not met, which is NOT MEASURED, not green**. Build first, then measure, and quote the gate's own verdict line.
- ⭐ **The budget has about 1% of headroom** — measured repeatedly this round at roughly 3234 KB against 3266.6 KB. If your move shifts the eager closure at all, report the delta explicitly rather than only the PASS.

**⛔ This is a tightening, and it must stay one.** The harm is that `ctx.user.isPlatformAdmin` and `ctx.user.id` **fault** on the missing keys, and a faulting visibility predicate **fails open** — so the `sys_environment` "Change Plan (admin)" gate silently does not bite. The fix restores the declared shape. Do not "resolve" any part of this by relaxing a gate, widening an accept set, or changing what happens when evaluation faults; the neighbouring family (#6443 / #6487 / #6445) preserved fail-open deliberately and this card is not the place to revisit it.

**Prove the published name did not move.** The point of re-exporting is that consumers see no change. Follow the chain the way this lane requires — a source `export` keyword is not the test, and neither is an unchanged entry-file diff. **Rebuild and confirm the package entry's built `.d.ts` still exports the same name with the same shape.** A move that silently drops or renames a published export is a worse defect than the one you are fixing.

**Add the pin #6110's contract implies but never got.** This card exists because a second mount site re-derived the shape by hand and nothing caught it. A shape pin that fails when any mount site publishes a `current_user` differing from the normaliser's output is what stops a third site doing it again — assert the **shape**, not merely that a function was called.

**Reverse verification.** Predict RED and observe it: a predicate naming `ctx.user.isPlatformAdmin` must fault and fail open before your change, and evaluate correctly after. Cover the signed-out branch as its own case. Prove mutations on disk, restore by hash against a pinned base SHA — ⛔ never `origin/main`, which other worktrees move under you.

**Fence and hygiene.**
- Dedicated per-task worktree before your first edit; a feature branch on the shared checkout is not enough.
- ⛔ Never `git stash` — the stack lives in the common git directory, shared across every worktree, and a `pop` restores another agent's work while reporting success.
- ⛔ Do not touch `content/docs/releases/`.
- **Claim first**: assign yourself and post a claim comment with your session ID and branch. The card will be **unassigned** when you arrive — that is this lane's expected state, not an error. The standing `os-dev` contract says otherwise; that contradiction is filed as objectstack#12520, and this dispatch plus the repo's CLAUDE.md govern.
- **Run tests narrowly** — the shared validation lock is a cross-agent resource and a wide run has been measured holding it nearly eighteen minutes. The console build you need for the budget gate is the exception; scope everything else.

Report your exact file face. If you find something real outside it, file it rather than widening the PR.

**Planned face:** move the `buildExpressionUser` normaliser to `packages/app-shell/src/providers/`, re-export from `AppContent` and the package index so the published name is unchanged, fix both mount sites plus the signed-out branch, and add the shape pin.
